name.ja: 鬼滅模型 我妻善逸

categories.ja: キャラクタープラモデル

description.ja: 『鬼滅の刃』より、プラモデル初心者でも簡単に組み立てられる「鬼滅模型」に我妻善逸がラインアップ！
description.en: From "Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba ", Zenitsu Agatsuma is joining the lineup of " Demon Slayer Models" that can be easily assembled even by plastic model beginners!

description.ja: タンポ印刷や塗装済パーツを採用し、組み立てやすさと高クオリティを両立！
description.en: Adopts pad printing and pre-painted parts to achieve both ease of assembly and high quality!

description.ja: • 接着剤不要の簡単組み立て。プラモデルが初めての方も不慣れな方も安心して楽しめる。
description.en: • Easy assembly without adhesive. People who are new to plastic models and those who are inexperienced can enjoy it with confidence.

description.ja: • 羽織や脚絆の柄や色分けは塗装済パーツを採用し、組み立てるだけでカラフルな仕上がりに。
description.en: • The pattern and color coding of the haori and leg ties are made of pre-painted parts, creating a colorful finish just by assembling them.

description.ja: • 目や眉はライトユーザーでも安心なタンポ印刷で再現。毛先の色分けは塗装済パーツで表現。
description.en: • Eyes and eyebrows are reproduced with tampo printing that is safe even for light users. The color coding of the tips of the hair is expressed with painted parts.

description.ja: • 隊服のシワ、羽織の翻った表現など、固定モデルだからこそできるこだわりの造形。
description.en: • The wrinkles on the uniform, the flaps of the haori, and other details that can only be achieved with a fixed model.

description.ja: • 必要な道具はニッパー(別売り)だけで、パズル感覚で楽しく組み立てができる。
description.en: • The only tool you need is nippers (sold separately), and you can enjoy assembling it like a puzzle.

description.ja: • 別売りの「鬼滅模型」アイテムと並べてディスプレイすることで劇中のイメージを演出。
description.en: • Create an image from the play by displaying it alongside the separately sold "Demon Slayer Model" item.
